# Modern upstream Xbox migration

Current hardware candidate: `8b92b320791d87d5cc1af6d9c8a9a777ba70b5282fbd0c9ead5006b7f3eceb42`.
The full modern game builds and boots on the physical 128 MiB Xbox with
direct nxdk-gles11. Menu/controller operation, Easy 1 and Easy 3 gameplay/coin collection, automatic
title replay, repeated restarts and menu Exit have been observed. Easy 3
access uses a backed-up unlocked-only test save. The user subsequently confirmed
local Easy-3 playability, correct coins, controls, music and effects on this
128 MiB console; see the ledger for the accepted XBE hash. See [the hardware ledger](hardware-testing.md) for
exact qualification and remaining checks. No emulator, release or master merge.

The sections below retain the initial evaluation and subsequent bring-up
evidence. The backend-only status applies to the initial stage.

## Initial evaluation, 2026-10-20

Branch: `codex/nxdk-gles11`, based on upstream-copy commit `0387f91e`.
Worktree: `/Users/zach/Developer/github.com/ZacharyLeahan/neverball/modern-xbox`.
This is an initial migration, not a working Xbox game build. No XBE was
produced or deployed and no hardware acceptance checks have run here.
Desktop Makefile targets are unchanged.

Prefer direct GLES provisionally. Modern `share/glext.h` already links GLES
1.1 entry points natively with `ENABLE_OPENGLES=1`; `share/glsl.c` disables
shader paths in that configuration. VBOs, indexed arrays, fixed-function
lighting, clipping, texture environments and particle point sprites match
the candidate backend's implemented entry points. Symbol availability is not
semantic or hardware qualification. Retain upstream gameplay and assets.

Pinned renderer: https://github.com/Ryzee119/nxdk-gles11 at
`0cf17fa709f42158d11a1571f87705b692699bd3`.
Its arena submodule is `30a1d31f19afb33d45be799dc971ee848ae26dca`.
The README reports Neverball rendering on real hardware; that does not qualify
this upstream revision. gl4es is disabled. Its extra desktop translation is
unnecessary for the existing GLES path; reassess only for a concrete unmet
requirement. The dependency's optional gl4es pin is
`81547d986798e876de8b434193920b606a72363f` and is not fetched here.

Important source findings:

- `gles_texture.c` asserts on subimage/copy/compressed texture operations.
  A search of current `share/` and `ball/` found no callers of these operations.
- `nv2a_helper.c:glFlipNV2A` already restores CONTROL0/depth/stencil state
  after pbkit presentation and waits for GPU completion before vertical blank.
  Do not import the older renderer's register writes.
- The staging arena is 2 MiB contiguous memory. `nv2a_helper.h`, included before
  `gles_private.h` fallback definitions, sets four texture units, four clip
  planes, a 4096-pixel maximum texture size and the OES extension string seen
  in the hardware log. The early audit read only fallback definitions; those
  are not the effective NV2A capabilities. Clip planes share texture stages.
  Do not raise advertised limits without validating the implementation.
- VBOs use contiguous allocations; client arrays are copied into staging.
  Texture storage, framebuffer/depth buffers, audio caches and transient level
  allocations also consume shared RAM. Measure peaks across transitions.
- `glContextInit` retries `pb_init` indefinitely. Initialization failure needs
  a bounded failure/reporting path before calling this production-ready.
- SDL's desktop GL context/swap lifecycle must be replaced for Xbox, using
  the backend context/flip hooks. Reinitialization and cleanup need auditing.

## Reproduce the backend compilation

Use the existing SDK for this initial compilation only. SDK used:
`/Users/zach/Developer/toolchains/nxdk`, documented older-port base
`14d5ee97e73347c973f1f57b68b79ec08c9e77f2` with local patches.
A fully clean, pinned SDK/game rebuild is still outstanding.

```sh
python3 scripts/bootstrap-xbox-renderer.py
export NXDK_DIR=/Users/zach/Developer/toolchains/nxdk
cmake -S xbox -B build/xbox-renderer \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$NXDK_DIR/share/toolchain-nxdk.cmake" \
  -DCMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_TARGET_TYPE=STATIC_LIBRARY
cmake --build build/xbox-renderer -j 4
```

All backend objects and static libraries compiled successfully. The local SDK
archive wrapper emits host ranlib warnings about COFF objects; successful
compilation alone does not verify final archive linkage or XBE creation.
The bootstrap refuses an existing renderer at a different revision or with
tracked changes. Submodules use the renderer's recorded revisions.

## Platform adaptation and provenance

The older port at https://github.com/ZacharyLeahan/neverball-nxdk remains a
separate reference and known-good installation. Its README, development notes,
hardware ledger, deployment/packaging tools, SDK bootstrap/patches and build
rules informed this evaluation. It continues JayFoxRox / Jannik Vogel's
original port at `42a8be94970117c91c4ed9c54f80713256138e56`.

`share/config.c` adapts direct key/value scanning from older-port commit
`3c59f35087f52ca39bca819e968df8bcace27f4a` (Zachary Leahan).
The upstream parser still used `%*s`, which the tested SDK's PDCLib mishandles.
A whole cherry-pick would pull unrelated old platform/renderer changes into
modern upstream. The adapted function passed seven host input cases under
AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, including whitespace, empty
values, missing delimiters, multiword values and NULL input.

Still to adapt after checking modern implementations: UTC replay timestamps
(`share/common.c` still dereferences `localtime`), RAM-backed Ogg input,
bounded decoder retries, mixer lock scope, audio buffering and controller
mapping. Keep overlay selection explicit and default release builds off.

Preserve all Neverball author and asset notices. Credit Ryzee119's backend,
JayFoxRox/xgu-gl lighting, dracc/xgu, arena, stb and other bundled notices.
The renderer has no top-level license file in this revision: retain and audit
per-file notices before distribution. In particular, README describes swizzle
as GPLv2 while bundled `lib/swizzle/swizzle.c` carries LGPL-2-or-later text
and Jannik Vogel, espes, Nouveau and Matt Borgerson copyrights. Preserve the
actual notices and resolve packaging requirements before a release.

## Physical hardware qualification

Only the older `v0.1.0-alpha.2` is qualified on the physical 128 MiB console.
Stock 64 MiB support remains unestablished. The known-good installation
`/F/neverball-nxdk` must remain intact. Use `/F/neverball-upstream` for future
modern candidates; do not copy the old deployment tool's default destination.

Rig: Xbox FTP `192.168.1.254`, ESP KVM `http://192.168.1.169/`.
KVM project: https://github.com/ZacharyLeahan/espkvm-xbox .
Dashboard FTP normally disappears during gameplay. Human dashboard return or
reboot may be necessary; no remote power control is assumed. Restore capture
settings after recording and prioritize physical-screen/controller feedback.

Next stages: link the complete modern game; stage current compiled assets;
retain licenses and source pins; deploy and read-back verify to the separate
directory; launch, record, gather logs/feedback, then fix. Record exact XBE
SHA-256 and evidence for responsive menu/title replay, playable Easy level 3,
fully visible coins, continuous music/effects, depth/presentation and repeated

## Full game build, 2026-10-20

The modern Neverball source now links to `bin/default.xbe` with direct GLES.
Initial candidate SHA-256:
`c1453c80f82f2844d3cfaae443d04c41c0b0d6055a1ad501e1c1c6e7c67842c6`.
This supersedes the backend-only status above. Hardware results are recorded
separately; a successful build is not hardware acceptance.

The local SDK was copied into ignored `build/nxdk` from the older port's
patched build, preserving its tested AC97/SDL changes without modifying it.
Clean SDK reproducibility remains unqualified. Renderer static libraries must
use LLVM ar/ranlib: Apple ar/ranlib omitted the COFF symbol index and caused
undefined GLES symbols at final link. `xbox/CMakeLists.txt` now selects LLVM.
The earlier backend-only build was insufficient to detect this issue.

```sh
python3 scripts/bootstrap-xbox-deps.py
python3 scripts/bootstrap-xbox-renderer.py
sh scripts/bootstrap-xbox-sdk.sh
export NXDK_DIR="$PWD/build/nxdk"
export PATH="$NXDK_DIR/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:$PATH"
make -f Makefile.nxdk -j4 hardware
make mapc sols ENABLE_NLS=0 ENABLE_FETCH=0 \
  CPPFLAGS=-I/opt/homebrew/opt/jpeg-turbo/include \
  'LDFLAGS=-L/opt/homebrew/opt/jpeg-turbo/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libpng/lib'
python3 scripts/stage-xbox.py
python3 scripts/xbox.py deploy
python3 scripts/xbox.py launch --quick
```

The deployment default is `/F/neverball-upstream`, and the helper rejects
`/F/neverball-nxdk`. Deployment verifies every file by readback. Launch rechecks
the candidate against its manifest; `--quick` trusts already verified assets.
The 429 compiled levels and 51 converted audio assets come from modern data.
Staging retains upstream notices plus dependency notices. Distribution still
needs a complete per-file renderer license audit.

Platform code uses FindFirstFile/FindNextFile for directories, ordinary PDCLib
stdio for miniz (archive timestamps disabled), direct GLES context/flip hooks,
UTC replay conversion, controller subsystem initialization/enumeration and
D-pad hat handling. A recovery thread requests reboot after 60 seconds with no
presentation progress; recovery is not guaranteed against kernel/GPU faults.
The development overlay is disabled. Every 300 frames stdout records free
physical pages via MmQueryStatistics. Menu Exit requests dashboard reboot.

Audio safeguards are adapted from neverball-nxdk `ed3fd13f`, incorporating
`3c59f350` and `aead2645`; modern logarithmic gain and cleanup behavior remain.
Modern fs_read has a three-argument byte-count API, so the RAM-source read was
adapted accordingly. Host sanitizers passed real title music and three sound
samples across thousands of mixer iterations with no decoder/seek failures.
Bounded retry tests passed empty loops, failed seeks, decode errors and holes.
Desktop `make test ENABLE_FETCH=0 ENABLE_NLS=0` passed.

The null fetch implementation now defines its declared FETCH_EVENT sentinel,
which was missing and prevented linking modern Neverball without libcurl.
Networking/downloading is disabled for the initial Xbox build.

A full desktop executable build was attempted but the host lacks SDL2_ttf's
`SDL_ttf.h`; it stopped before linking. Desktop unit tests and the host map
compiler/asset build passed. No host game or emulator was run.

The copied SDK's actual HEAD is `c5c574c6ba5778595b782064044ff56b407e835b`,
which is base `14d5ee97e73347c973f1f57b68b79ec08c9e77f2` plus the committed
AC97 ready-link fix. Tracked working-tree changes also include the cxbe patch
and SDL audio patches. All four retained patches passed reverse-apply checks
against the copied source. The bootstrap recreates base-plus-patches rather
than depending on that unpublished local SDK commit. SDL source HEAD is
`2554902f7` (as pinned by the SDK). A clean binary rebuild remains unqualified.
Replay UTC conversion provenance is older-port commit
`458301d1f3e1989bdf8b09060d3f3540531b0b46` (Zachary Leahan).
